title: SADAS: A Dialogue Assistant System Towards Remediating Norm Violations in Bilingual Socio-Cultural Conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the dialogue system's ability to detect, assess, and remediate socio-cultural norm violations and cultural insensitivities in bilingual conversations using the SocialDial dataset, measured through classification metrics (F1-score), text generation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L), and human preference evaluations.
